report.clinical_summary: Patient has been living with a chronic illness for several years and describes it as something they will have for the rest of their life. The medication has helped keep their viral load under control but they are experiencing significant side effects including severe headaches (described as 'vise around my skull'), fatigue, and sleep issues. They have considered skipping doses due to the burden of side effects and worry about long-term effects of the medication. They have good understanding of when the medication works but feel uncertain about how to integrate other approaches like exercise, nutrition, and stress management into their daily life. They have supportive friends and family but worry about being a burden. They have experienced changes in identity, having to let go of some ambitions, and at times feel the illness defines them. They struggle with uncertainty about what is real vs. imagined and find medical explanations confusing at times.
